rows.quote: MATERIALS AND METHODS: Discovery MR utilized protein quantitative trait loci (pQTL) data on 4907 plasma protein levels from 35,559 individuals, alongside genome-wide association study (GWAS) on MASLD from the Million Veteran Program (68,725 cases / 95,482 controls).
rows.coder_note: The sentence names the programme's own GWAS as the outcome source; the dictionary has no outcome row for a GWAS of that programme alone.
The abstract gives a protein count and the cohort name only; no sample size, citation or accession separates the candidate rows.
